why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Open Linera Markets Visit linera.io to see how the markets work, then use its Trade button, which leads to linera.market .
2 Step 2 : Go to the Linera Portal Open the Linera Portal , where a Launch App button opens the markets app and a Portal wallet section lets you connect a wallet.
3 Step 3 : Pick an Original On the portal, choose one of the Linera Originals, which are different ways to watch the same live BTC minute play out.
4 Step 4 : Request testnet tokens Developers can follow the Hello, Linera guide to initialize a wallet and request a microchain from the Conway faucet.
5 Step 5 : Publish the counter example The same guide builds and publishes a counter application, then queries its value through GraphQL on your own machine.
